desired_yaml:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: nginx-prod
  namespace: nginx-prod
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: nginx-prod
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: Helm
    app.kubernetes.io/name: nginx
    app.kubernetes.io/version: 1.31.7
    helm.sh/chart: nginx-25.2.5
    environment: prod
spec:
  revisionHistoryLimit: 10
  strategy:
    rollingUpdate: {}
    type: RollingUpdate
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/instance: nginx-prod
      app.kubernetes.io/name: nginx
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/instance: nginx-prod
        app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: Helm
        app.kubernetes.io/name: nginx
        app.kubernetes.io/version: 1.31.7
        helm.sh/chart: nginx-25.2.5
      annotations:
        checksum/server-block-configuration: 98a3b1e3871f1455e2ee1c3c29585cc50ce7248cacef5f90d01e09c9b2861e96
    spec:
      shareProcessNamespace: false
      serviceAccountName: nginx-prod
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      enableServiceLinks: true
      affinity:
        podAffinity: null
        podAntiAffinity:
          preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
          - podAffinityTerm:
              labelSelector:
                matchLabels:
                  app.kubernetes.io/instance: nginx-prod
                  app.kubernetes.io/name: nginx
              topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
            weight: 1
        nodeAffinity: null
      hostNetwork: false
      hostIPC: false
      securityContext:
        fsGroup: 1001
        fsGroupChangePolicy: Always
        supplementalGroups: []
        sysctls: []
      initContainers:
      - name: preserve-logs-symlinks
        image: registry-1.docker.io/bitnami/nginx:1.31.7
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        securityContext:
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL
          privileged: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          runAsGroup: 1001
          runAsNonRoot: true
          runAsUser: 1001
          seLinuxOptions: {}
          seccompProfile:
            type: RuntimeDefault
        resources:
          limits:
            cpu: 150m
            ephemeral-storage: 2Gi
            memory: 192Mi
          requests:
            cpu: 100m
            ephemeral-storage: 50Mi
            memory: 128Mi
        env:
        - name: OPENSSL_FIPS
          value: 'yes'
        command:
        - /bin/bash
        args:
        - -ec
        - "#!/bin/bash\n. /opt/bitnami/scripts/libfs.sh\n# We copy the logs folder\
          \ because it has symlinks to stdout and stderr\nif ! is_dir_empty /opt/bitnami/nginx/logs;\
          \ then\n  cp -r /opt/bitnami/nginx/logs /emptydir/app-logs-dir\nfi\n"
        volumeMounts:
        - name: empty-dir
          mountPath: /emptydir
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: registry-1.docker.io/bitnami/nginx:1.31.7
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        securityContext:
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL
          privileged: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          runAsGroup: 1001
          runAsNonRoot: true
          runAsUser: 1001
          seLinuxOptions: {}
          seccompProfile:
            type: RuntimeDefault
        env:
        - name: BITNAMI_DEBUG
          value: 'false'
        - name: NGINX_HTTP_PORT_NUMBER
          value: '8080'
        - name: OPENSSL_FIPS
          value: 'yes'
        - name: NGINX_HTTPS_PORT_NUMBER
          value: '8443'
        - name: DB_PASSWORD
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              key: password
              name: nginx-db-secret
        envFrom: null
        ports:
        - name: http
          containerPort: 8080
        - name: https
          containerPort: 8443
        livenessProbe:
          failureThreshold: 6
          initialDelaySeconds: 30
          periodSeconds: 10
          successThreshold: 1
          timeoutSeconds: 5
          tcpSocket:
            port: http
        readinessProbe:
          failureThreshold: 3
          initialDelaySeconds: 5
          periodSeconds: 5
          successThreshold: 1
          timeoutSeconds: 3
          httpGet:
            path: /
            port: http
        resources:
          limits:
            cpu: 150m
            ephemeral-storage: 2Gi
            memory: 192Mi
          requests:
            cpu: 100m
            ephemeral-storage: 50Mi
            memory: 128Mi
        volumeMounts:
        - name: empty-dir
          mountPath: /tmp
          subPath: tmp-dir
        - name: empty-dir
          mountPath: /opt/bitnami/nginx/conf
          subPath: app-conf-dir
        - name: empty-dir
          mountPath: /opt/bitnami/nginx/logs
          subPath: app-logs-dir
        - name: empty-dir
          mountPath: /opt/bitnami/nginx/tmp
          subPath: app-tmp-dir
        - name: nginx-server-block
          mountPath: /opt/bitnami/nginx/conf/server_blocks
        - name: certificate
          mountPath: /certs
      volumes:
      - name: empty-dir
        emptyDir: {}
      - name: certificate
        secret:
          secretName: nginx-prod-tls
          items:
          - key: tls.crt
            path: tls.crt
          - key: tls.key
            path: tls.key
      - name: nginx-server-block
        configMap:
          name: nginx-prod-server-block
